response_headers.content-security-policy: default-src 'none'; script-src https://static.cloudflareinsights.com; connect-src https://cloudflareinsights.com; frame-ancestors https://freetwai.com; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

interpretation.siteToken: Public analytics site identifier observed in the fetched document and intercepted beacon; not a member identifier.
interpretation.pageloadId: Beacon contains a per-page-load identifier; do not describe it as identifier-free.
interpretation.network: Actual deployment sends normal request network metadata to the external service; this isolated probe delivered no beacons.
interpretation.privacy: No parent URL marker, referrer, cookie/storage operations, or stored keys observed in this fresh-context run. This does not establish all browser histories, future external revisions, backend storage, retention, or no-IP processing.
